display_name: Martha, mother of Symeon of the Wonderful Mountain

names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 4 iulie, «Sfânta Cuvioasă Marta».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Ιουλίου, «Οσία Μάρθα μητέρα του οσίου Συμεών, που ασκήτευσε στο όρος Θαυμαστόν», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 4. јул ст. ст., „Св. Марта. Мајка св. Симеона Дивногорца (в. 24 маја)“ — Св. is not a rank and this heading carries no rank word at all. What follows the full stop, „Мајка св. Симеона Дивногорца (в. 24 маја)“, is a second sentence of the heading describing whose mother she was and pointing at another day; **it is not part of her name and is not built onto the form**, though this corpus’s own display name uses the same fact to tell her apart. The bare forename is what the heading gives of the name. `foldchk.py` returns `martha-sister-of-lazarus`, `sr`, for «Марта», so this is the second folder on the string, and the heading offers no by-name to break it with.

The whole of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name link for her, «Марфа Антиохийская, Едесская», which carries no rank word; the day line gives «Прп. Марфы», the bare forename in the genitive, so both epithets are read from the name link. `fk.mjs` returns no other holder for «антиохииская едесская марфа».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 июля ст. ст. — «Прп. Марфы , матери прп. Симеона Дивногорца (551).»

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, and this folder’s woman: the same menologion day its Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows already keep, the same grade, the same son named beside her, and 551, which is the year this folder’s `dates` already hold. `dates` unchanged. Name page 2605 gives her two epithets the other calendars of this folder do not print, «Марфа Антиохийская, Едесская». The reading life4154 behind the line WAS NOT OPENED. Three hymns were taken of the four headings that name her: a FOURTH, «Кондак преподобной Марфы», глас 2, carries a text addressed to «Андрее преподобне» and not to her — a proper of somebody else hung under her name — and it was NOT taken (BRIEF.md §4).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 4 iulie — «Sfânta Cuvioasă Marta»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Ιουλίου — «Οσία Μάρθα μητέρα του οσίου Συμεών, που ασκήτευσε στο όρος Θαυμαστόν»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the day's line gives her the same identification the folder does — mother of the venerable Symeon who lived on the Wonderful Mountain. The page closes by saying «(Η μνήμη της φέρεται και κατά την 1η Σεπτεμβρίου)», that her memory is borne also on 1 September; one attestation row per church is the schema, so that second day is recorded here and not as a second row. The page gives no year. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 17.07.2026 (4. јул ст. ст.) — „Св. Марта. Мајка св. Симеона Дивногорца (в. 24 маја)“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, and its heading is two sentences and a cross-reference, quoted whole as §4 requires. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. The Julian 4 July is the same menologion number this folder’s Romanian and Greek rows carry, so there is no second day and no §4 note is owed. **THE „(в. “ INSTRUMENT, AND WHY IT WAS NOT NEEDED.** The standing instrument for an entry that ends in „(в. “ and a date is to read the Prologue’s own other day, and here the reference is „(в. 24 маја)“ and it is **about her son and not about her**. It did not have to be followed: this folder’s display name is already «Martha, mother of Symeon of the Wonderful Mountain», it already relates `symeon-of-the-wonderful-mountain`, and its own life already records that doxologia places that Symeon’s commemoration on 24 May — the same number this heading gives. Two books and the folder itself agree on who the son is, so the reference is resolved without a fetch, and **the Julian 24 May was not read**, being outside this reader’s range. **AND THE TRAP IN THE BODY, WHICH THE FOLDER WAS ALREADY BUILT AGAINST.** This book’s last sentence about the burial calls her son „Симеона Столпника“ — Symeon the Stylite, flat. `symeon-the-stylite` is a folder and that is its display name exactly, and it is a **different man**, the elder, whose own mother this corpus keeps on 1 September. The folder’s life says so in as many words already. **No row for `symeon-the-stylite` and the name is kept out of the new prose entirely**, which is §6’s rule and, after 2 July, the second time in this range that the exact string «Symeon the Stylite» had to be held out of a paragraph. **THE FIRST DATE OF ANY KIND THIS FOLDER HAS HELD.** `dates` was **null**: doxologia gives no year for her birth or her death and saint.gr gives none either. This book says „Упокојила се мирно 551 год.“ — she reposed in peace in the year 551. One book, one year, stated flat: `death` 551 to 551, display «551», basis traditional. **Nothing is widened**, no second book giving a year to widen against, and **the year before her death in which she saw the angels is a duration and not a date**. WHAT IS NEW. **A betrothal, and the Forerunner’s counsel to go through with it.** The folder had a divine vision in the church of the Forerunner commanding her to obey her parents, and the appearing of John the Forerunner announcing the gift of a son. This book has the two as one scene and adds the betrothal itself: her parents betrothed her to a young man, she determined to leave her father’s house and withdraw from the world, and the Forerunner appeared and counselled her to do her parents’ will and enter the marriage, which she did. **The midnight rule**: „Имала постојан обичај устајати у поноћи на молитву“, a settled habit of rising at midnight to pray, where the folder had only that she was first at the singing and last to leave. **The angels with candles**: a year before her death she saw a multitude of angels with candles in their hands and learned from them the time of her death, and knowing it gave herself to prayer and good works with still greater zeal — which no other book has. **TWO SMALL DISAGREEMENTS, BOTH WRITTEN AND NEITHER CHOSEN.** The burial: this book has her buried from the first beside her son’s pillar, where saint.gr has her buried at Daphne near Antioch and the son said to have moved her relic to the pillar later. The lamp: this book has the person who let it go out be **the superior of Symeon’s monastery**, who set it there himself with a resolve that it should never be put out and then fell ill when people grew slack, where the folder has a sick man. Her speech is quoted whole — „Знајте, да мени није потребна светлост од ваших свећа, пошто сам се удостојила код Бога вечне небесне светлости; но то је потребно за вас“ — and the entry draws from it the conclusion that the point of our honouring the saints is to move them to pray for us. `types` UNTOUCHED: `venerable` is there and „Св.“ is not a rank, this heading carrying no rank word at all — **so nothing is added**, and `virgin` would be the opposite of what the entry says in any case. No `office`, no `locations`: Antioch is not even named here. **NO NEW ROWS.** The folder already relates `symeon-of-the-wonderful-mountain`, who is her son and whose row is the one relation this entry supports. **John the Forerunner takes no row**: an appearance is not a relation, which is the Three Hierarchs ruling, and the folder’s older prose names him already without one. The young man she was betrothed to and the husband are unnamed; the superior of the monastery is unnamed; the angels are not folders. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse. **THE DAY REFUSES NOBODY.** Both of its entries are persons, both are held, and both are upgrades — the first day of this range on which Ruling 3 has nothing to do. Nineteen days before this range had produced no new folder and four days in five had refused somebody; this is the fifth.

hymns.text: Întru tine, maică, cu osârdie s-a mântuit cel după chip; că, luând crucea, ai urmat lui Hristos; şi lucrând, ai învăţat să nu se uite la trup, căci este trecător; ci să poarte grijă de suflet, de lucrul cel nemuritor. Pentru aceasta şi cu îngerii împreună se bucură, Cuvioasă Maică Marta, duhul tău.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfintei Cuvioase Marta; the text is the common of a venerable woman, printed with her name in it.

english.text: In you, mother, that which was made in God's image was saved with diligence; for taking up the cross you followed Christ, and by your works you taught us to overlook the flesh, since it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore your spirit rejoices with the angels, venerable mother Martha.

hymns.text: Житием чистым и любовию, яже ко Пречистей Божией Матери,/ стяжала еси дар чадородия преславный,/ светильника миру, дивнаго Симеона,/ тем тя, Марфо,/ яко матерь, о чаде веселящуюся, песньми ублажаем.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 июля ст. ст., «Тропарь преподобной Марфы», глас 4

english.text: By a pure life, and by thy love for the Most Pure Mother of God, thou didst gain the most glorious gift of childbearing — a lamp for the world, the wondrous Symeon; therefore, O Martha, we bless thee with hymns as a mother who rejoices in her child.

hymns.text: В тебе, мати, известно спасеся, еже по образу:/ приимши бо крест, последовала еси Христу/ и, деющи, учила еси презирати убо плоть, преходит бо,/ прилежати же о души, вещи безсмертней./ Темже и со Ангелы срадуется, преподобная Марфо, дух твой.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 июля ст. ст., «Ин тропарь преподобной Марфы», глас 8 — the common of a venerable woman with her name set into it, which is hers and is copied whole

english.text: In thee, O mother, that which is according to the image was surely saved; for taking up the cross thou didst follow Christ, and by thy deeds thou didst teach us to despise the flesh, since it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore, O venerable Martha, thy spirit rejoices together with the angels.

hymns.text: В молитвах Господеви предстоящи,/ Пречистей Деве Богородице пение и хвалы приносящи,/ Марфо честная,/ породила еси священное отроча,/ Симеона предивнаго, светильника всемирнаго,/ с нимже моли присно о всех нас.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 июля ст. ст., «Кондак преподобной Марфы», глас 2

english.text: Standing before the Lord in prayer and bringing song and praise to the Most Pure Virgin Mother of God, O honourable Martha, thou didst bear a holy child, Symeon the most wondrous, a lamp for the whole world; with him pray without ceasing for us all.

death.note: The folder’s first date of any kind; `dates` was null before this reading, doxologia giving no year for her birth or her death and saint.gr none either. The Охридски пролог for 4. јул ст. ст.: „Упокојила се мирно 551 год.“ — she reposed in peace in the year 551. One book, one year, stated flat, and nothing is widened for want of a second year to widen against. The year before her death in which she saw a multitude of angels with candles and learned the time of her death is a duration and not a date (5 October 2026).
